Class Appointment

java.lang.Object
edu.secourse.patientportal.model.Appointment
@Entity public class Appointment extends Object
Entity representing a scheduled appointment between a Patient and a Doctor.

This class models appointment data including participants, timing, and status. It is mapped to the appointments table and uses JPA relationships to link patients and doctors.

Persistence Details:

  • Mapped to appointments table
  • Uses ManyToOne relationships for Patient and Doctor
  • Primary key is auto-generated

Core Responsibilities:

  • Store appointment scheduling data
  • Track appointment status
  • Maintain modification timestamps

      public Appointment(Patient patient, Doctor doctor, LocalDateTime appointmentDateTime)
      Constructs an appointment with required fields.

      Automatically sets:

      • End time to 30 minutes after start time

      • Last updated timestamp
